source.name: When the focused control inside a focus trap removes itself, focus must stay inside the trap
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/focus-trap/focus-trap/pull/932) at 0eca669477eb3e25c197809efbbbd8fc451eb346. Blind to the maintainers' fix fce60b3a737759c6e0e787d3fa1603f2cb86300a; routing auto.

journey.title: Focus stays in the results dialog after Show all removes itself
journey.goal: Activating a control that removes itself keeps keyboard focus inside the trapped dialog

functionalJourney.title: Show all results with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens, lists every result and closes

guards.title: Escape closes results and returns focus
guards.goal: Escape dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: The Show all button removes itself from the DOM while it has focus, causing focus to leave the dialog and breaking the :focus-within assertion.
plan.repair_strategy: Move focus to another focusable element inside the dialog (the close button) before removing the Show all button, ensuring focus remains trapped.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Focus remains inside the results dialog after activating Show all, preserving modal keyboard navigation and the :focus-within state.
functional_risks: None; the button removal and list update remain unchanged, only focus is redirected to an existing focusable element.
verification_requirements: After clicking Show all, focus must be on a focusable element inside #results (e.g., #close).
The count must update to '4 of 4 results'.
Escape key must still close the dialog and return focus to the opener button.
Tab navigation must stay trapped within the dialog.

attempts.failure: Patch preimage must match exactly once

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Focus remains inside the results dialog after activating Show all, preserving modal keyboard navigation and the :focus-within state.
